Calendar:
-- rebuilt from DAX: CALENDAR("04/01/2026", TODAY())
-- note: assumed MM/DD/YYYY
SELECT calendar_date AS "date",
       TRIM(TO_CHAR(calendar_date, 'Month')) AS "Month Name",
       EXTRACT(YEAR FROM calendar_date) AS "year",
       TRIM(TO_CHAR(calendar_date, 'Month')) || ' ' || TO_CHAR(calendar_date, 'YYYY') AS "Month Year",
       CAST(TO_CHAR(calendar_date, 'YYYY') || TO_CHAR(calendar_date, 'MM') AS INTEGER) AS "Month Year Sort"
FROM sys_calendar.calendar
WHERE calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND CURRENT_DATE
AI Studio Mnthly:
SELECT astudio.*, CAST(SUBSTR(CAST(period_strt_ts AT TIME ZONE 'GMT' AS VARCHAR(50)), 1, 10) AS DATE FORMAT 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS log_dt
FROM ACC_TED_CON_VW.dbp_site_ai_studio_metering_mnthly AS astudio
